principles: Avoid duplicate or lightly transformed posts
Avoid irrelevant long captions and hashtag stuffing
Create content that sustains real discussion

feed_post.body: story, useful detail, or community prompt

length_guidance.post: Depth may be long when useful; remove unrelated filler.

link_policy: No blanket penalty encoded. Use links when they serve the user and measure results manually.

cadence_prior.status: upper-volume starting hypothesis; reduce if quality suffers
